remarks: This stunning 3 bedroom home is ready for it's new owner! Located on a cul-de-sac with supreme privacy, gardens and mature landscaping. Beautifully updated with the perfect layout for today's lifestyle. Amazing eat-in kitchen with walk-out to backyard and bluestone patio. Spacious and open living and dining room. Second floor with primary bedroom/bath w/radiant floors and 2 additional bedrooms with hallway bath. Don't miss the finished lower level complete with laundry room & 1 car garage/storage. Brand new windows, garage door, upgraded electrical panel & light fixtures. Fully encapsulated crawlspace with GE humidifier. This one will not last! Convenient location: close to schools, shops, and all major transportation. Expansion opportunity and gas on street.
